notes.title: Small Update For Your favorite Arcade Boxer!
notes.notes: Throwdown Boxing 2 has been updated to ver. 10.3 with small changes to dlc, additional animation sprites and font changes. Please enjoy!

notes.title: Get readt to THROW DOWN!
notes.notes: Throwdown is that fun loving arcade boxer you've been yearning for, From a one person design and programming crew who's pored his heart and love for gaming into this piece, you'll be playing, discovering and dreaming about your rise to the top! Let's Throw Down!

notes.title: Let's Go Throw Down!
notes.notes: A massive update has been unleashed for Throw Down Boxing 2!!! This is the game I've been working hard on to deliver a fun and humorous experience to all games. With improved animation, excellent gameplay and sound, Let's Go Throw Down!!!

notes.title: Catch my theme!
notes.notes: Fixed issues with training mode menu. Changed Ned, Robo-sno, Oslama, and Thump's dialog themes. Tweaked several graphics assets, song composures and character animations.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541285/c98369f4ad0f0608faf1d61a02df06be39ba9724.png[/img]

notes.title: Throwdown Boxing 2 revision 8.0 hits the streets!
notes.notes:
Each revision of Throwdown Boxing 2 brings us closer to perfection and the latest, 8.0 provides a big leap closer. Character opponents have been given more vocal interaction and tweaked maneuvers allowing you to deal more damage to them or feel the pain! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541285/6ee1dd971a5eb4ced0afe4161c0f9dc1105e09f9.png[/img]

notes.title: Throwdown Boxing 2 Update 7.0 is Live!
notes.notes: Revision 7.0 brings even more life to your opponents and you, Kid Titan. Work your way through the circuits, train hard and become the T.D.B.A. World Champ, and with experience, the undisputed Dream Champion![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541285/17477a359e6cc51818a7a2ac41243ba7dbb30a4b.png[/img]

notes.title: Throwdown Boxing's been updated to ver. 6.1!
notes.notes: Minor update to ver. 6.1 with graphical tweaks! Have a blast!

notes.title: Rev. 6.0 is Live!
notes.notes: This update adds more fluid animations and tighter gameplay. Additional hidden bonus and cheats have been added. Go luck and have a blast!

notes.title: Throwdown Boxing 2 Let the King Reign
notes.notes:
The main event is here. Throwdown Boxing 2 Ver. 5.0 is the classic colorful old school arcade styled boxing game you've been looking for! With brutal hits, comical play and bumping music, the battle's here!. This major update adds more beautiful music tracks, awards tracking and progress saves, and crazy amount of gameplay secrets and powerups for you to discover! So get your copy of TDB2 today because the Rumble is Ready! This game was made by me for the love of punch out and the for the fun the be had in the arcades, Let's Go!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541285/65ea85479cf12561797bcf5af6d2da3d8cdc94ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Throwdown Boxing 2 ver. 4.0!
notes.notes: Throwdown Boxing 2 has been updated to version 4.0! New music for Human Beat Boxer, an ingame exit button, tweaks to graphics, sound and menu functions! Please enjoy, and your feedback is very much appreciated!

Major update includes gameplay tweaks, improved animations and sound, added secrets, more special effects and bug fixes!
